mathTerms: E = integral of incident radiance * N.L over the hemisphere (irradiance), stored pre-exposed
gaps: Stochastic direct-lighting permutation writes a different history/atlas pair (Lumen.SceneDirectLighting.*History).
Shadow-mask tile packing (8 or 16 bits/texel) is a separate input; see parameter schema FShadowMaskRay.
